## Task declaration

Complete this declaration before coding and keep the external contract beside it. Link the external contract/snapshot; do not paste secrets or bulky evidence into the PR.

- Task ID:

### Outputs and effects

For each generated, ignored or retained output, state its destination, class, tracked status, generator/source and effect (`read-only`, `local-write`, `emulator-write`, `remote-write` or `billable`).

-

### Protected contracts

List served URLs, API/data/audio/scoring/provenance contracts, load order, persistence and adjacent flows that must remain valid.

-

### Verification

List meaningful tests and checks, including the Chrome flow when UI behavior is affected. Documentation-only changes may state why product tests do not apply.

-

### Exceptions and unresolved decisions

Every exception needs an actual owner, rationale, evidence and review/expiry status. Do not use a blanket `**` declaration, fictitious owner or assumed remote branch protection.

-

## Completion review

- [ ] The final worktree/index delta matches the declaration; unrelated user changes are preserved.
- [ ] Canonical inputs, generated outputs, intentional copies and evidence are identified.
- [ ] New tests/checks passed and their exact commands/results are recorded below.
- [ ] Retained evidence has a source SHA, tool/input identity, hashes and restore route.
